name: Glossy Glimpse Auto Studio | Nelson | NZ

reviews.name: himanshu kadyan
reviews.text: I recently had my vehicle detailed by Glossy Glimps Auto Detailing, and I couldn’t be happier with the results. The team delivered an exceptional level of care and attention to detail throughout the entire process. Their deep cleaning service was outstanding, leaving every part of the vehicle looking fresh, spotless, and revitalized. The polishing work was equally impressive, restoring a brilliant shine that made the car look almost brand new. Their professionalism, dedication, and commitment to quality truly stand out. I highly recommend Glossy Glimps Auto Detailing to anyone looking for top-quality vehicle detailing services.

reviews.name: Prabhjit Kaur
reviews.text:
Comprehensive Cut & Polish + Ceramic Coating
Took my vehicle to Glossy Glimpse Auto Studio for a full exterior cut and polish, and the results exceeded my expectations. They removed years of swirl marks and imperfections, bringing the paintwork back to life with an incredible mirror finish.

The ceramic coating has taken the finish to another level, adding impressive gloss and protection while making the paint look absolutely stunning.

If you’re looking for top-tier car detailing in Nelson, I highly recommend Glossy Glimpse Auto Studio. Their attention to detail, precision, and knowledge really stand out. Easily one of the best auto detailing studios in town!

reviews.name: Bethany Gentry
reviews.text:
Really had high hopes, initially thought they had done a good job. Left polish residue almost everywhere, didn't clean rear view mirror, did a poor job on the wheels, left spray residue all over the dash. Didn't bother to put some interior compartments back in place after cleaning. Not very premium but whatever, fixable on my end. Then I saw all the scratches in multiple places around the exterior that did not exist prior to handing my car over. Not minor scratches either, almost as if they had used a pot scrub in some areas.
Sure, they offered for me to bring it back to inspect scratches and rectify the poor cleaning job, however if they can't do the job right the first time, I would not trust them a second time. Don't go here with if you want your paint to stay in good condition. Paid $195 for scratches and a subpar clean.

Edit: Just confirmed they also broke the separator slot in my cupholder, was wondering why there was a random piece of metal there. Part of the slot has been broken, so will need to glue. They must have also discarded the plastic tab that attaches to the metal bit, so can't even fix it.
